question: When you and your friends paint a large wall together, what are you working as? 🤝
explanation: Super! When we share ideas and work together to create a big piece of art, we are working as a wonderful team! 🤝
hint: You work together instead of alone.

question: What is the best way to start a group art project? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Talking and planning together helps everyone know exactly what to do! 🌟
hint: It involves sharing your ideas before starting.

question: What do we call a huge painting made by many friends on a big wall? 🧱
explanation: Great job! A mural is a very large painting that a team creates on a wall. 🖌️
hint: It sounds like 'plural' but starts with M.

question: If a friend wants a sun but you want a moon in the picture, what should you do? ☀️🌙
explanation: Fantastic! Mixing both ideas makes the artwork extra special and keeps everyone happy! ✨
hint: Put both your thoughts into the art.

question: What does wet glue need before you can paint over it? ⏱️
explanation: Spot on! We must use our time wisely and wait patiently for the glue to dry. 🕰️
hint: You have to wait for the clock to tick.

question: If your team has many tasks, how should you share the work? ✂️
explanation: Brilliant! Dividing tasks means everyone gets a fun job to do! 🎉
hint: Give one job to each friend.

question: What technique uses both wax crayons and water colors together? 🖍️💧
explanation: Super! The wax pushes away the wet paint, making a magic resist effect! ✨
hint: The wax 'fights off' the water.

question: How do we make a paper collage? 📰
explanation: Awesome! Tearing colorful paper and sticking it down creates a beautiful collage! 🌈
hint: You rip it and stick it.

question: What is the best way to talk to your team while making art? 🗣️
explanation: Great job! Speaking softly and kindly makes the art room a happy place to work. 😊
hint: Use nice and polite words.

question: What do we do after finishing our group art activity? 🧹
explanation: Fantastic! A good team always cleans up the art space together! 🧽
hint: You wash the brushes and sweep the floor.

question: If your team's clay model is wet, what does it need? ☀️
explanation: Super! Wet clay needs time to dry and become hard and strong. 🏺
hint: You must wait patiently.

question: Which tool helps us draw perfectly straight lines? 📏
explanation: Awesome! A ruler is a simple technique to keep all our straight lines perfect. ✏️
hint: It has numbers on it and is made of plastic or wood.

question: When a friend shares a new art idea, what should you do? 👂
explanation: Great job! Good team members always listen nicely to each other's creative ideas. 💡
hint: Use your ears and pay attention.

question: What happens when we mix blue and yellow paint together? 💙💛
explanation: Brilliant! Mixing colors is a fun technique to create brand new colors! 🎨
hint: It is the color of fresh grass.

question: What do we use to fill a very big space with paint quickly? 🖌️
explanation: Super! Using a big brush saves time when painting huge backgrounds. ⏱️
hint: A tool with lots of thick bristles.

question: How should a team handle a single box of crayons? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! Sharing materials is the best way to show great teamwork! 🤗
hint: You take turns using them.

question: What technique uses newspapers and wet glue to make 3D shapes? 🗞️
explanation: Fantastic! Paper mache is a fun technique of layering paper to build strong models. 📰
hint: It involves sticky paste and old news pages.

question: Before using expensive paints, what is a good planning step? 📝
explanation: Great job! Drawing a light pencil sketch saves time and helps the team plan! 📐
hint: You draw lightly with a pencil.

question: If an art project takes two weeks to finish, what do you need? 📅
explanation: Super! Big, beautiful projects take time, so we must work patiently. ⏳
hint: It means waiting calmly without rushing.

question: What technique mixes rough and smooth things in art? 🧶
explanation: Awesome! Texture is how art feels, like fluffy cotton or rough sand! 🖐️
hint: It is how something feels when you touch it.

question: What happens when someone makes a small mistake in team art? 😲
explanation: Brilliant! Mistakes can be turned into beautiful new ideas by a smart team! ✨
hint: Turn the 'oops' into a new shape.

question: When making a puppet theater as a team, what material is best? 📦
explanation: Great job! A cardboard box is strong and easy to cut for fun team crafts. ✂️
hint: It is brown, thick, and used for packing.

question: To make art with dried leaves, what technique is fun to use? 🍂
explanation: Super! Placing a leaf under paper and rubbing a crayon shows the leaf's pretty lines! 🌿
hint: You rub a crayon over the hidden leaf.

question: What does a team leader do during an art project? 👑
explanation: Awesome! A good leader helps everyone manage their time and work happily! 🌟
hint: They help and show the way.

question: How can a team combine many small pictures into one big art piece? 🧩
explanation: Fantastic! A collage is a wonderful technique to bring everyone's art together! 🤝
hint: You stick pieces together to make a big picture.

question: If you are sticking heavy buttons to a canvas, what do you need? 🧵
explanation: Great job! Heavy items need strong glue and extra time to dry perfectly. ⏱️
hint: A thick, sticky liquid that holds well.

question: What is the best way to learn a new art technique? 🧑‍🏫
explanation: Super! Trying new steps and practicing makes our art better every day! 🌟
hint: Look carefully and then try it yourself.

question: To draw things that are very far away, how should you draw them? 🏞️
explanation: Awesome! This is a technique called perspective. Far things look tiny! 🔭
hint: Think of an airplane high in the sky.

question: To draw a flower that is right in front of you, how should you draw it? 🌻
explanation: Brilliant! Things that are close to us look very big and detailed. 🌸
hint: Make it take up lots of space on the paper.

question: What is a safe and neat way to use liquid glue? 🧴
explanation: Great job! A small drop of glue is the best technique to keep paper neat and flat! 📄
hint: Remember the rhyme: dot, dot, not a lot.

question: Which of these paints dries the fastest? ⏱️
explanation: Super! Watercolors are quick to dry, helping us manage our art time well! 💧
hint: The paint that uses a lot of water.

question: What is the best tool for blending soft oil pastels together? 🖍️
explanation: Awesome! Our own fingers are the best tools for smudging and blending pastels smoothly! ✨
hint: They are attached to your hands.

question: How do we weave colorful paper strips? 🌈
explanation: Fantastic! Weaving paper over and under is a fun, old technique that creates nice patterns. 🧺
hint: You go on top, then below, then on top.

question: When working in a team, what makes the project fun? 🎈
explanation: Great job! Smiling and having fun with friends is the best part of team art! 🎉
hint: Smiling and enjoying the activity.

question: If a team project has ten steps, what is the best plan? 📋
explanation: Super! Making a list helps the team manage time and finish every step properly. ✅
hint: Write them down in order.

question: To make a color darker, what small trick can you use? 🎨
explanation: Awesome! Adding a tiny bit of black is a technique to make nice, dark shades! 🌌
hint: Add the color of the night sky.

question: To make a color lighter, what should you mix in? 🖌️
explanation: Brilliant! Mixing white paint makes lovely, soft, light colors! ☁️
hint: Add the color of milk.

question: What is a fun team game to create silly art? 🎲
explanation: Great job! Passing a drawing around lets everyone add their own fun technique! 🔄
hint: You hand your paper to the next person.

question: If you want to draw tiny details, which brush is best? 🖌️
explanation: Super! A tiny brush is perfect for careful details and tricky lines! ✨
hint: A brush that is very very small.

question: What technique uses thousands of tiny dots to make a picture? 🔵
explanation: Awesome! Pointillism is a patient technique of using dots instead of lines! 🌟
hint: The word starts with 'Point'.

question: What can you use cut ladies' fingers (okra) for in art? 🥦
explanation: Fantastic! Stamping vegetables in paint is a super fun printmaking technique! 🥔
hint: You dip it in paint and stamp it.

question: How can you trace a perfect circle? ⭕
explanation: Great job! A bangle or a cup is a great tool to trace perfect round circles! 🟡
hint: A round piece of jewelry worn on the wrist.

question: When a team presents their finished art, how do they feel? 🥰
explanation: Super! Hard work and good teamwork make us feel proud of our beautiful art! 🎉
hint: They feel joyful and glad.

question: What is the secret to good teamwork? 🗝️
explanation: Awesome! Helping friends makes the team strong and the art amazing! 🌟
hint: Supporting and caring for each other.

question: What technique involves folding paper to make birds and boats? 🦢
explanation: Brilliant! Origami is a calm technique of folding paper without using scissors! ⛵
hint: A Japanese paper folding art.

question: What helps a team know when the art time is over? ⏰
explanation: Great job! Keeping an eye on the clock helps us manage our time perfectly. ⏱️
hint: It has hands and says tick-tock.

question: How can you make art using old buttons and strings? 🧵
explanation: Super! Recycling old things to make beautiful art is a great technique! 🌍
hint: Using waste materials to make something new.

question: What is the best way to choose colors for a group poster? 🌈
explanation: Awesome! Voting as a team ensures everyone gets a choice in the colors! 🎨
hint: Raise your hands to make a choice.

question: To make an art piece extra bright, what colors are best? ☀️
explanation: Fantastic! Bright colors like yellow and orange make the art pop and look cheerful! 🌼
hint: Colors that shine like the sun.

question: What is the most important rule in the art room? 🧑‍🎨
explanation: Great job! Respecting tools, time, and team members makes art class the best! 💖
hint: Be kind and careful with everything and everyone.
